task:
In the backend, anyone can edit or delete any comment. Only the comment's author should be allowed to.

- Change commentService.update to update(commentId, userId, content) and commentService.delete to delete(commentId, userId).
- Both must first load the comment (add commentQuery.findById(id)). If it doesn't exist, throw AppError(ErrorCodes.COMMENT_NOT_FOUND, 404). If its userId isn't the given userId, throw AppError(ErrorCodes.FORBIDDEN, 403) and change nothing.
- Keep commentQuery.update(id, content) and commentQuery.delete(id) as they are.
- Pass the signed-in user's id from the comment controller, and update the existing tests.
